name: Sector 7
reasonForRisk: Urban drainage corridor adjacent to Sion-Panvel Highway; prone to moderate gutter overflow during intense monsoon cloudbursts.
action: Exercise caution at subway underpasses and monitor municipal drainage updates.

name: Sector 10
reasonForRisk: Elevated residential area with moderate natural slope toward central stormwater culverts.
action: Normal precautions. Keep local building stormwater drains clear of debris.

name: Sector 12
reasonForRisk: Moderate residential gradient with planned CIDCO box drains leading to Kopra creek channel.
action: Stay alert during concurrent high tide and heavy downpours.

name: Sector 15
reasonForRisk: Intermediate catchment zone between railway line and residential pocket; junction water accumulation possible during cloudbursts.
action: Avoid parking vehicles in basement or low stilt lots during heavy rainfall warnings.

name: Sector 19
reasonForRisk: Low-lying proximity to Kopra bridge nullah with natural runoff concentration descending from Kharghar hills.
action: High caution. Avoid waterlogged internal roads and follow municipal advisory.

name: Sector 20
reasonForRisk: Low elevation zone near drainage culvert junction with historical waterlogging history.
action: Avoid waterlogged roads and monitor official alerts. Elevate sensitive equipment.

name: Sector 21
reasonForRisk: Convergence of natural hillside runoff towards arterial road nullah.
action: Drive with caution along main access avenues. Keep away from uncovered drainage channels.

name: Sector 35
nearbyWaterBody: Kasadi River / Owe Stream Drainage Basin
reasonForRisk: Low-lying pocket near Taloja river / Kasadi backwater influence and Owe hill runoff.
action: High risk zone. Avoid low-lying basements, keep emergency kit ready, follow evacuation advisories.

name: Sector 36
reasonForRisk: Adjacent to Taloja river floodplain and tidal drainage basin with restricted outflow during high tide.
action: Very high modeled risk. Move valuables to higher floors; do not cross flooded culverts.

name: Central Park Area
nearbyWaterBody: Central Park Retention Lake & Golf Ponds
reasonForRisk: Large planned open retention landscape with natural percolation grounds and golf course water bodies.
action: Lower modeled risk. General caution around decorative water retention ponds.

name: Kharghar Railway Station
reasonForRisk: Critical transport hub; pedestrian subway and forecourt prone to stormwater pooling during concurrent high tide.
action: Use foot overbridges instead of submerged subways. Check suburban train updates.

name: Utsav Chowk
reasonForRisk: Major elevated traffic circle with radial stormwater drainage into arterial channels.
action: Drive at reduced speed; watch for slow-moving traffic around roundabout.

name: ISKCON Kharghar
reasonForRisk: Elevated foothill terrain overlooking Central Park with high natural drainage gradient.
action: Lower modeled risk. Normal monsoon precautions.

name: Taloja-side Surroundings
reasonForRisk: Low-lying Kasadi river bank and industrial drainage corridor subject to severe tidal backflow during high tides.
action: Critical vigilance. Avoid transit near riverbank; stay tuned to Panvel Municipal Corporation (PMC) alerts.
